豆腐西施话音落下

村头所有人的目光，全都齐刷刷朝着李老屯手中的炮仗望了过去，要不是豆腐西施提醒，大家还真没看见李老屯手里的这挂炮仗。

“咋了，李青山这狼崽子死在老林子里面了，我还不能庆祝庆祝了？”

李老屯冷哼一声道。

村头的一众村民相互对视一眼，不再言语，不想得罪老李家，但是村子里的豆腐西施则是忍不住了，开口道：“李老屯，你还是个人吗？那怎么也是你孙子啊，心咋这么歹毒呢？”

“你一个臭卖豆腐的娘们管这么多干什么？”

“当初分家的时候，李青山这小狼崽子，可是一点面子也没给我这张老脸留，他死了我怎么就不能庆祝庆祝了？”

李老屯声音洪亮，显得中气十足道。

“李老屯，干得好，我支持你，李青山这小崽子太不是东西了，死了倒也活该。”

麻子婶拎着孙子泥鳅，在一旁开口助威道。

“就是，死了就死了呗，还不允许人家放炮仗不成，李青山这小子打小就不孝顺，平日里尽是干些偷鸡摸狗的事情，死在老林子里面倒也活该，省的到时候出来祸害人。”

人群中。

一名穿着有些破烂，浑身满是嗖臭味道，与李青山相差不多的年轻人赵铁蛋道。

这小子是石溪村著名的懒汉，父母死得早，也就无人管了。

上次见到李青山狩到这么多的野物，两只眼睛都红了，恨不得冲上去掐死李青山。

凭什么他李青山能猎到这么多野物？

凭什么不能是自己？

真是该死。

所以，心里早早的就对李青山嫉妒无比，现在找到了机会，自然是落井下石，大骂特骂。

村子里，总归是有这么一些人的。

“赵铁蛋，你胡吣什么？”

就在这时。

一道女子奶凶的声音突然在身后响起，赵铁蛋转头望去，正好见到王春晓拎着一根条子便朝着自己身上狠狠抽了过来。

“啪！”

措不及防之下，还真是一鞭子抽在赵铁蛋的身上，疼的赵铁蛋哎呦一声，直接从地上蹦了起来，瞪着奶凶奶凶的王春晓道：“王春晓，你干哈？”

“干哈？”

“我抽死你，看你以后还胡吣不！”

“正事不干，就知道在村头咒人死？”

王春晓哪里肯放过赵铁蛋，一边说着，一边拎着条子就朝着赵铁蛋身上招呼着。

赵铁蛋本想还手。

Tofu Xishi's voice fell

Everyone in the village looked at the firecrackers in Li Laotun's hands. If it hadn't been for Tofu Xishi's reminder, no one would have seen the firecrackers in Li Laotun's hands.

"What's wrong? Li Qingshan, the wolf cub, died in the old forest. Can't I celebrate anymore?"

Li Laotun snorted coldly.

The villagers at the head of the village looked at each other and stopped talking, not wanting to offend the old Li family, but the tofu Xishi in the village couldn't help it and said: "Li Laotun, are you still a human being? Then he is also your grandson, why is he so vicious?"

"Why do you, a stinky bitch like you, care about so much?"

"When we separated, that little wolf Li Qingshan didn't give me any face. Why can't I celebrate when he dies?"

Li Laotun's voice was loud and full of energy.

"Li Laotun, good job. I support you. This little brat Li Qingshan is nothing. He deserves to die."

Aunt Mazi was carrying her grandson Loach and cheering from the side.

"That's right, if you die, just die. People are not allowed to set off firecrackers. This kid Li Qingshan has been unfilial since he was a child. He does all kinds of sneaky things on weekdays. He deserves to die in the old forest, so as not to come out to cause harm to others."

in the crowd.

Zhao Tiedan, a young man whose clothes were somewhat tattered and whose whole body was full of the smell of whoosh, looked similar to Li Qingshan, said.

This boy is a famous lazy man in Shixi Village. His parents died early, so no one took care of him.

The last time I saw Li Qingshan hunt so many wild animals, his eyes were red and he wanted to rush up and strangle Li Qingshan to death.

Why could Li Qingshan hunt so many wild animals?

Why can't it be myself?

Damn it.

Therefore, I have been extremely jealous of Li Qingshan for a long time. Now that I have found the opportunity, I naturally add insult to injury and curse.

There are always some people like this in the village.

"Zhao Tiedan, what are you talking about?"

Just then.

A woman's fierce voice suddenly sounded behind him. Zhao Tiedan turned his head and looked around, just in time to see Wang Chunxiao holding a stick and swiping it towards him.

"Crack!"

Unprepared, Zhao Tiedan was hit with a whip. Zhao Tiedan screamed in pain and jumped up from the ground. He stared at the fierce Wang Chunxiao and said, "Wang Chunxiao, what are you doing?"

"What?"

"I'll beat you to death and let's see if you behave like this in the future!"

"If you don't do business, you just want to curse people to death in the village?"

Wang Chunxiao was not willing to let Zhao Tiedan go. As he spoke, he held the note and greeted Zhao Tiedan.

Zhao Tiedan wanted to fight back.
